name: shirabe-reader
description: Parse Japanese on any web page and look it up with Shirabe.

scripts.dev: npm run prepare:dev-pack && node build.mjs firefox --watch --serve
scripts.dev:chrome: npm run prepare:dev-pack && node build.mjs chrome --watch --serve
scripts.package:firefox: node test/release-package.mjs firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts/firefox --overwrite-dest --filename shirabe-reader-firefox.zip
scripts.package:chrome: node test/release-package.mjs chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir artifacts/chrome --overwrite-dest --filename shirabe-reader-chrome.zip
